events.title: atai share price at or above twice its 16 May 2025 close
events.proposition: The Nasdaq closing price of atai Life Sciences (ATAI, or its successor listing) is at or above two times its closing price on 16 May 2025, per Nasdaq closing prices.
events.criterion: Resolved on the named data series only: the Nasdaq daily closing price of atai Life Sciences common stock (ATAI, or its successor listing), adjusted for any split or reverse split. The reference price is the ATAI Nasdaq close on 2025-05-16. TRUE on the first trading day after the statement date on which the closing price is at or above 2.0 times the reference price. The threshold is in the forecaster's words ('a multiple of where it trades today', read at its lower bound of two times), so it resolves as binary at 2.0 with no band. FALSE at the window end when no close has reached 2.0 times the reference price. readings: 'A multiple of where it trades today' is read at its lower bound: a closing price at least two times the 2025-05-16 close, the smallest multiple.

'It of course always depends on the broader macro environment for biotech' is a hedge, not an observable condition; it is not coded as a condition.
